description: Preferred exploratory forward-paper candidate; retain the current strategy as benchmark. Uses an 8% initial stop, +15% closing-profit target and +10% closing breakeven trigger (1.25R), with protection active from the following session. The existing engine also retains the 8% best-close trailing fallback after activation. Risk is 1.5%; choose 1% if lower drawdown is the priority. Five positions, 40% breadth with existing 80% coverage, signal volume at least 1x prior average and average turnover at least Rs 5 crore. Review scheduled events before new purchases; this is a manual requirement, not an automated event gate. The optional 3% opening-gap challenger is disabled, as are extension restrictions, early-failure exits, stalled exits and fixed re-entry cooldowns. Reported exploratory result: Rs 56,603 net profit on Rs 1 lakh, 8.10% maximum drawdown; not independently rerun for this preset. Raising the trigger does not directly rescue the 38 existing losers, none of which reached +8% closing gain. Current constituents, unverified corporate-action adjustments and full-snapshot exclusions limit historical inference. The filter audit covers the usable frozen universe, not all 318 exclusions. Includes Zerodha fees and modeled slippage; realistic opening execution remains a limitation.
